title: Acceptance of a finite assignment
statement: Let $F$ be a family of Boolean circuits, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $v$ be a Boolean assignment to the $m$ input positions. The length-$m$ word whose bits are given by $v$ belongs to the language accepted by $F$ if and only if the circuit in $F$ for inputs of length $m$ outputs true on $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean assignment to the $m$ input positions
